description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the LoanAccountOwnerTransferService interface, specifically the class LoanAccountOwnerTransferServiceImpl. It manages external asset owner transfers related to loan accounts, including handling transfer cancellations, declines, and execution of buy-back transfers. It interacts with repositories, services, and event notifiers to perform transfer lifecycle operations, and is part of the 'org.apache.fineract.investor.service' package.

classes.name: LoanAccountOwnerTransferServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of transfer handling logic for loan account owner transfers, including handling transfer cancellations, declines, and buybacks.

methods.name: handleLoanClosedOrOverpaid
methods.description: Main method to handle the scenario when a loan is closed or overpaid, triggering transfer cancellations, declines, or executions based on transfer status and timing.

methods.name: cancelTransfer
methods.description: Cancels a pending transfer and notifies relevant business events.

methods.name: declineTransfer
methods.description: Declines a transfer and updates its status accordingly.

methods.name: executePendingBuybackTransfer
methods.description: Executes a buy-back transfer by updating statuses, deleting mappings, posting journal entries, and notifying events.

methods.name: createCancelledTransfer
methods.description: Creates and persists a transfer with status CANCELLED based on a pending transfer.

methods.name: createDeclinedTransfer
methods.description: Creates and persists a transfer with status DECLINED based on a pending transfer.

methods.name: updatePendingTransfer
methods.description: Updates the effective date of a pending transfer to the current business date.

methods.name: updatePendingBuybackTransfer
methods.description: Updates a buyback transfer with the current date and transfer details.

methods.name: updateActiveTransfer
methods.description: Updates the effective date of an active transfer.

methods.name: createAssetOwnerTransferDetails
methods.description: Creates detailed transfer info, including outstanding principal and interest.

methods.name: findActiveOrActiveIntermediateTransfer
methods.description: Finds an active or intermediate transfer for a loan and owner.

methods.name: findAllPendingOrBuybackOrIntermediateTransfers
methods.description: Retrieves all relevant transfers for a loan pending or in buyback/intermediate status.

methods.name: isBiggerThanZero
methods.description: Utility to check if a BigDecimal is greater than zero.

methods.name: isSameDayTransfers
methods.description: Checks if all transfers in the list are settled on the same day.
